'''Jimmy Ray''' (Japanese: '''ヨシヒコ''' ''Yoshihiko'') is a minor recurring character in {{aniseries|BW}}.

He debuted in ''[[BW039|Reunion Battles In Nimbasa!]]'', where he participated in the [[Club Battle]] tournament and was {{an|Iris}}'s first opponent. His most notable feature is the {{p|Watchog}} [[Pokémon cosplay|costume]] he wears. Not much is known about him as he is defeated by Iris in the first round during ''[[BW040|Cilan Versus Trip, Ash Versus Georgia!]]'', and thus knocked out of the tournament.
